subject: upper and lower bound of the scale scores (different values)

messages.author: 40fc57d53124bd8d
messages.subject: upper and lower bound of the scale scores (different values)
parts:
Hi Phil, 

I different values for upper and lower bound scale scores. For example, the lower bound is -2.5 and the upper bound is 4.5. How can I set them up using max_theta? 

Thank you!
Emily

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: upper and lower bound of the scale scores (different values)
parts:
You can't, at least not the way that max_theta has been organized internally. Why not just manually truncate these values after estimation anyway?

fs <- fscores(mod)
fs <- ifelse(fs < -2.5, -2.5, fs)
fs <- ifelse(fs > 4.5, 4.5, fs)  
head(fs)

If all you need these for is some type of truncation then these can be applied post-hoc.

Phil
